shortDescription: Manage HTTP analytics profiles on a BIG-IP

options.name: collect_geo
options.description: Enables or disables the collection of the names of the countries from where the traffic was sent.

options.name: collect_ip
options.description: Enables or disables the collection of client IPs statistics.

options.name: collect_max_tps_and_throughput
options.description: Enables or disables the collection of maximum TPS and throughput for all collected entities.

options.name: collect_page_load_time
options.description: Enables or disables the collection of the page load time statistics.

options.name: collect_url
options.description: Enables or disables the collection of requested URL statistics.

options.name: collect_user_agent
options.description: Enables or disables the collection of user agents.

options.name: collect_user_sessions
options.description: Enables or disables the collection of the unique user sessions.

options.name: collected_stats_external_logging
options.description: Enables or disables the external logging of the collected statistics.

options.name: collected_stats_internal_logging
options.description: Enables or disables the internal logging of the collected statistics.

options.name: external_logging_publisher
options.description: Specifies the external logging publisher used to send statistical data to one or more destinations.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the profile.

options.name: notification_by_email
options.description: Enables or disables sending the analytics alerts by email.

options.name: notification_by_syslog
options.description: Enables or disables logging of the analytics alerts into the Syslog.

options.name: notification_email_addresses
options.description: Specifies which email addresses receive alerts by email when C(notification_by_email) is enabled.

options.name: parent
options.description: Specifies the profile from which this profile inherits settings. When creating a new profile, if this parameter is not specified, the default is the system-supplied C(analytics) profile.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the profile exists. When C(absent), ensures the profile is removed.
